def execute_parallel_convergence_league(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Ekko creates a delayed slowing zone; entering it at the right time grants a shield and stuns foes.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    defense = attach_defense_rule_to_actor_or_zone(target)
    on_incoming_hit(hit):
        if matches_defense_filter(hit,defense): reduce_block_or_reflect(hit)
        else: pass_through_normal_hit_resolution(hit)
    on_depletion_or_expiry: remove_defense_rule(defense)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS

abilities.targeting: self historical snapshot plus nearby foes
suggested_game_logic: Record Ekko position and health history in time ring buffer.
On cast make Ekko untargetable only during the specified transition.
Move him to past position, restore qualifying health, then explode on arrival.
